allocation_guard.required: calls, allocated bytes, and incremental region peak do not grow materially

constructor_ir.required: selected constructor Ir decreases in both repeats

quality.required: quality gates and correctness checks pass

comparison.policy: Adopt only if all four primary workflow p50 values improve by at least 3% in both paired repeats, constructor Ir decreases in both repeats, allocation calls/bytes/incremental peak do not grow materially, and correctness/quality pass. Review every >5% matched latency/RSS regression and every absolute >5% same-build variation. No stable-tail or broad provider/scaling claim. If primary admission fails, reject production change and retain useful differential tests only when independent of candidate API. The four primaries and thresholds are unchanged from 0524, stricter than a one-cell-only gate. Final retained runtime+tests binary must be measured; any changed rebuild requires a fresh full ABBA.
comparison.limits: Matched deltas are descriptive evidence for this fixed workload. A production decision also requires independent constructor-Ir and quality gates; no broad provider, producer, scaling, or ODF claim.
